coach_analysis:
SESSION: Interval Workout (unplanned — athlete deviated from prescribed session), Aug 12, 6:35pm
Structure: 4x800m efforts with jogging recovery between reps (athlete-improvised, not per plan)

REP SPLITS:
Rep 1: 0.80km, 2:52, 3:33/km
Rep 2: 0.79km, 2:59, 3:46/km
Rep 3: 0.81km, 3:14, 3:59/km
Rep 4: 0.81km, 3:12, 3:56/km

RECOVERY JOGS:
Rest 1: 0.39km, 2:53, 7:20/km
Rest 2: 0.43km, 3:51, 8:54/km
Rest 3: 0.47km, 4:29, 9:32/km
Rest 4: 0.42km, 4:40, 11:02/km

SESSION TOTALS: 5.02km, avg HR 149, max HR 184, suffer score 32, cadence 157.8 spm (below 170 spm floor)

ASSESSMENT:
- All 4 reps ran faster than prescribed interval pace ceiling (3:50-4:05/km) and well outside tempo zone (4:10-4:15/km); reps 1-2 were run at 5K-effort pace, not tempo/threshold effort.
- Clear fade pattern across reps: 3:33 -> 3:46 -> 3:59 -> 3:56/km (~26 sec/km slowdown from rep 1 to rep 3), consistent with an overly aggressive start.
- Recovery jogs progressively slowed and lengthened (7:20 -> 8:54 -> 9:32 -> 11:02/km, rest duration 2:53 -> 4:40), indicating cumulative fatigue and incomplete recovery between reps.
- Cadence 157.8 spm continues a two-session-running trend below the 170 spm floor.

DIRECTIVES FOR NEXT QUALITY SESSION:
1. Set and hold a hard pace ceiling before starting (3:50/km min for intervals, or 4:10/km for tempo) — decide session type in advance, not mid-run.
2. Target even or slightly negative splits across reps; rep 1 should not be the fastest rep by a wide margin.
3. Standardize recovery interval (fixed time/distance) to enable clean fatigue comparison across future sessions.
4. Cadence correction remains outstanding across two consecutive sessions — active metronome cueing recommended at target 170-176 spm.

NOTE: This session replaces the originally scheduled workout for this date; logged as athlete-initiated deviation from plan, not a missed/rescheduled prescribed session.
